==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Nicknamed "'''Top 3'''" by the Brazilian community as a reference to several tierlists made by streamers and influencers that placed him as the top 3 player in the AD Carry position in Brazil. Ironically, he won three splits of '''CBLOL''' between '''Summer 2023''' and '''Winter 2024'''.<ref>[https://x.com/ilhadaslendas/status/1782871716407980033 Ilha das Lendas' X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
* His {{ci|kaisa}} quadrakill against [[FURIA]] was featured on a '''LoL Esports Top 5 Plays of the Week''' as the '''Top 5'''.<ref>[https://x.com/lolesports/status/1821201288756965503 LoL Esports' X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
* He gained a large fanbase in Brazil during his passage in [[LOUD]], who created a "religion" for the player, called "'''Routism'''".<ref>[https://x.com/LOUDgg/status/1870228170563023124 LOUD's X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
* The first foreigner adcarry in CBLOL history to win a title, becoming the 1st player to do so.

===Individual Awards===
* 1x CBLOL 1st Round-Robin Team (2024 Split 2)
* 1x CBLOL 1st Round-Robin MVP (2024 Split 2)
